verdict.rationale: Anytype ships an official MCP server converting its API into MCP tools so AI assistants can manage the knowledge base 'through conversation' and 'natural language,' plus an Agents Skill enabling agent-capable tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) to run natural-language-driven scripts against Anytype data. This is first-party documented and corroborated by GitHub repo mentioning AI Agents extensibility. missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports confirming natural-language command reliability in practice, and no evidence of built-in NL command bar inside the app itself.
